title: REQ · 80/20 layout with independent story scroll and mobile bottom drawer
summary: 80/20 layout and collapsible mobile story drawer composed in App
description: Context: components from R2 and R3 exist. Desired behavior: GameLayout renders scene at 80% and story panel at 20% with its own overflow scroll; below a 768px breakpoint the panel becomes a bottom drawer with a toggle button (aria-expanded) while ActionMenu stays in the scene area. App wires useGame, SceneView, ActionMenu, StoryPanel and IntroScreen. Expected result: playable on desktop and mobile. Why: responsive requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Given the layout renders, When drawer toggle is clicked, Then aria-expanded becomes 'true'
Given the drawer is open, When toggle is clicked again, Then aria-expanded becomes 'false'
Given the drawer is closed, When rendered, Then the action menu remains in the document
Given styles.css, When read, Then story panel has overflow-y auto and a max-width 768px media query

out_of_scope: Contribution form and 'Suggest What Happens Next' flow
preserve: game/src/** engine, systems and state modules unchanged

technical_constraints: Reuse game/src runtime via imports; do not copy it
definition_of_done: Acceptance criteria demonstrated by unit tests
